answer: One defense is work-history-bound, soulbound reputation that decays like umber fading in sunlight. Each agent's standing lives in an on-chain vault of peer-attested work receipts earned across many epochs and can never be transferred. A sybil attacker spinning up ten thousand fresh keys gets ten thousand zeros: each fake identity must redo real work to gain standing, so the cost scales linearly with the swarm. Sybils that vouch for each other form a dense reef in the vouch graph; the protocol flags such reef-shaped cliques and slashes the whole cluster once one member is caught cheating.
